# Sea Raider Traits and Talents Summary

*Pages PDF 18-21*

## **Sea Raider Traits and Talents Summary**
## Dark Elf
Hatred (High Elves): The Character must make a Cool Test on encountering High Elves. If failed, they are subject to Hatred. At the end of every subsequent round, they can make a Cool Test to bring the Hatred to an end. Whilst subject to Hatred the Character must try to destroy the target by the fastest and most deadly means, and benefits from +1 SL to all combat Tests against the target and is immune to Fear and Intimidate caused by the target. 

Night Vision: Provided there is a dim source of illumination the Character can see 20 yards in darkness, or they may see 20 yards further than a Character with an illumination source would normally see. 

## Ship’s Crew
Old Salt: The Character ignores negative modifiers to Tests at sea derived from poor conditions and counts as two seamen when calculating the minimum crew of a sea-going vessel. 

Pilot: If the Character fails a Test to pass through dangerous waters, they may reverse the result if it scores a success but may not score more than +1 SL if they do so. 

Sea Legs: Under normal conditions, the Character never Tests to see if they become seasick. Under abnormal conditions the Character ignores penalties to Tests to avoid sea sickness. 

Strong Swimmer: The Character adds 1 to their Toughness Bonus for the purpose of holding their breath. 

## Druchii Sorceress
Aethyric Attunement: The Character does not suffer a Miscast if they roll a double on a successful Casting Test. 

Arcane Magic: The Character may access Arcane Magic Spells. 

Attractive: If the Character successfully uses Charm they may use scored SL, or swap them with the number on the units die. 

Instinctive Diction: The Character does not suffer a Miscast if they roll a double on a successful Language (Magick) Test. 

Petty Magic: The Character may access Petty Magic Spells. 

Read/Write: The Character may read and write. 

Second Sight: The Character can perceive the Winds of Magic. 

Sixth Sense: The Character may make an Intuition Test to receive a warning feeling if they are about to walk into danger. They may ignore Surprise if the pass an Intuition Test. 

## Oarsman
Old Salt: The Character ignores negative modifiers to Tests at sea derived from poor conditions and counts as two seamen when calculating the minimum crew of a sea-going vessel. 

Sea Legs: Under normal conditions, the Character never Tests to see if they become seasick. Under abnormal conditions the Character ignores penalties to Tests to avoid sea sickness. 

Stone Soup: The Character can subsist on half the food required, and tests for Starvation every 3 days, not 2. 

Strong Back: The Character adds +1 SL to Opposed Strength Tests and may carry 1 extra point of Encumbrance. 

## Corsair
Dual Wielder: When armed with two weapons the Character may attack with both. They first roll to hit with the weapon in their primary hand. If they hit retain the dice from the roll to hit and work out Damage as normal. Reverse the score on the dice to see if they hit an available opponent with the weapon in their secondary hand. This second attack is modified by the offhand penalty (-20) unless the Character has the Ambidextrous Talent. If the first to hit roll scores a Critical do not reverse the dice from the to hit roll, but instead use the score rolled on the Critical Hit table as the score for the attack with the secondary hand. When using this Talent, all defensive rolls suffer a penalty of -10 until the start of the next turn, and a Character does not gain Advantage unless both attacks hit. 

In-fighter: The Character suffers no penalties for fighting an opponent with a longer weapon. If using the rules for infighting on page 297 of the Warhammer Fantasy Roleplay Core Rulebook the Character gains a bonus of +10 to hit. 

Sea Legs: Under normal conditions, the Character never Tests to see if they become seasick. Under abnormal conditions the Character ignores penalties to Tests to avoid sea sickness. 

## Lookout
Flee!: The Character’s Movement is 1 higher when Fleeing. 

Old Salt: The Character ignores negative modifiers to Tests at sea derived from poor conditions and counts as two seamen when calculating the minimum crew of a sea-going vessel. 

Sea Legs: Under normal conditions, the Character never Tests to see if they become seasick. Under abnormal conditions the Character ignores penalties to Tests to avoid sea sickness.

When using this Talent, all defensive rolls suffer a penalty of -10 until the start of the next turn, and a Character does not gain Advantage unless both attacks hit. 

Furious Assault: Once per round, if the Character hit their opponent in combat, they may spend an Advantage or their Move to make an extra attack. 

In-fighter: The Character suffers no penalties for fighting an opponent with a longer weapon. If using the rules for infighting on page 297 of the Warhammer Fantasy Roleplay Core Rulebook the Character gains a bonus of +10 to hit. 

Menacing: The Character gains +1 SL when using Intimidate. 

Pilot: If the Character fails a Test to pass through dangerous waters, they may reverse the result if it scores a success but may not score more than +1 SL if they do so. 

Public Speaker: The Character can influence 5 times the normal number of people when using the Charm Skill when public speaking. 

Read/Write: The Character may read and write. 

Sea Legs: Under normal conditions, the Character never Tests to see if they become seasick. Under abnormal conditions the Character ignores penalties to Tests to avoid sea sickness. 

Strong Swimmer: The Character adds 1 to their Toughness Bonus for the purpose of holding their breath. 

## Beastmaster
Animal Affinity: Creatures with the Bestial Trait are calm in the presence of the Character unless they have reason not to be. Crack the Whip: If an animal the Character controls is fleeing or running it gains +1 Movement if the Character uses a whip. Read/Write: The Character may read and write. 

## Reaver Captain
Catfall: If the Character falls, they may take an Athletics Test. For every +1 SL scored on the Test they count as falling 1 less yard for the purpose of taking Damage. 

Combat Reflexes: The Character adds 10 to their Initiative for the purposes of determining Combat Initiative.
